parameters.name: TimeStamp
parameters.description: Date and Time at which the entry was added to the {{object}} table.

parameters.name: EventType
parameters.description: Type of event for this entry. {{enum}}

parameters.name: ReporterDeviceId
parameters.description: 1905 AL MAC Address of device which reported the change.

parameters.name: ReporterInterfaceId
parameters.description: MAC Address of the interface of the reporting device on which the change has been detected.

parameters.name: NeighborType
parameters.description: Type of Neighbor for this event. {{enum}}

parameters.name: NeighborId
parameters.description: MAC Address of the Neighbor of this event. If the value of the {{param|EventType}} parameter is {{enum|NewNeighbor|EventType}}, then the value of this parameter represents the MAC Address of the new Neighbor that joined the network; if the value of the {{param|EventType}} parameter is {{enum|LostNeighbor|EventType}}, then the value of this parameter represents the MAC Address of the Neighbor that left the network. If value of the {{param|NeighborType}} parameter is {{enum|IEEE1905|NeighborType}}, then the value of this parameter is the 1905 AL MAC Address of the Neighbor.

object.description: This object represents log entries for changes in the 1905 Network Topology. The Change Log is a First In First Out queue where the oldest entries (defined by values of the {{param|TimeStamp}} parameter) are deleted once the log is full.
